description: ON THE DAY INTACCR CLOSES A MONTH, WRITES THE MONTH'S CHARGES
AND CREDITS AS TRANSACTIONS FOR TXPOST: THE INTEREST DUE,
CREDITED (IN) OR CHARGED AS OVERDRAFT INTEREST (OD), AND THE
MAINTENANCE FEE (MF) OF AN OPEN CURRENT ACCOUNT WHOSE BALANCE
CLOSED THE MONTH BELOW THE WAIVER BALANCE. ON OTHER DAYS IT
THE MASTER AND THE ACCRUALS ARE READ IN STEP, SO THE
TRANSACTIONS COME OUT IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER, AND TXPOST
POSTS THEM WITHOUT A SORT. TRANSACTION IDS ARE 00, THE CLOSED
MONTH AS YYMM, AND A SEQUENCE NUMBER.
RETURN CODES: 0 WRITTEN, 16 FILES OUT OF STEP OR I/O.

identification.text: FIRST BANK OF PANGAEA, DATA CENTER.

records.name: BANK-CONTROL-RECORD
records.description: BANKCTL: BANK CONTROL RECORD, ONE PER FILE THE BUSINESS DATE THE BATCH RUNS FOR, NEVER THE CLOCK.

records.name: ACCT-MASTER-RECORD
records.description: ACCTMAST: ACCOUNT MASTER RECORD, 100 BYTES IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER. THE BALANCE MAY GO BELOW ZERO DOWN TO THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT, AND BELOW THAT ONLY BY FEES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1994-11-14 PK  CR-0201 OVERDRAFT LIMIT, FROM THE FILLER. 1999-01-11 SL  Y2K: 8-DIGIT DATES.

records.name: ACCRUAL-RECORD
records.description: ACCRREC: INTEREST ACCRUAL RECORD, 40 BYTES ONE PER ACCOUNT, IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER LIKE THE MASTER. INTEREST IS ACCRUED FOR EVERY CALENDAR DAY BEFORE THE THROUGH DATE, TO SIX DECIMALS, AND IS NEGATIVE FOR AN OVERDRAWN BALANCE. WHEN A MONTH CLOSES, ITS INTEREST BECOMES DUE, ROUNDED TO THE CENT; THE FRACTION STAYS ACCRUED. THE DUE MONTH IS ZERO ON THE DAYS NO MONTH CLOSES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 ORIGINAL VERSION.

records.name: WS-MAINTENANCE-FEE
records.description: THE MAINTENANCE FEE, AND THE BALANCE THAT WAIVES IT.

records.name: TRAN-RECORD
records.description: TRANREC: DAILY TRANSACTION FILE RECORD, 80 BYTES ONE HEADER, THE DETAILS, ONE TRAILER, TOLD APART BY THE RECORD TYPE. THE BODY IS REDEFINED FOR EACH RECORD TYPE. THE TRAILER CARRIES THE SENDER'S CONTROL TOTALS: THE DETAIL COUNT, THE SUM OF AMOUNTS AND THE SUM OF ACCOUNT NUMBERS. A TRANSFER (TR) NAMES THE ACCOUNT IT GOES TO. POSTING SPLITS IT IN TWO: THE DEBIT ON THE SENDING ACCOUNT, THEN A TRANSFER CREDIT (TC) ON THE RECEIVING ONE. A CREDIT THAT CANNOT POST GOES BACK AS A RETURNED TRANSFER (RT). TC AND RT ARE MADE BY POSTING, NEVER RECEIVED IN THE DAILY FILE. WHEN A MONTH CLOSES, THE BANK CREDITS ITS INTEREST (IN), CHARGES OVERDRAFT INTEREST (OD) AND THE MAINTENANCE FEE (MF). THESE TOO ARE NEVER RECEIVED IN THE DAILY FILE. THE CARD FILE, FROM THE ONLINE DAY'S HOLDS, HAS THE SAME FORM AND ITS OWN SOURCE: CARD PURCHASES (CP), ATM WITHDRAWALS (AW) AND ATM FEES (AF), WHICH WERE AUTHORIZED WHEN THEY WERE MADE. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1991-06-03 PK  CR-0117 ACCOUNT NUMBER HASH IN THE TRAILER. 1996-04-15 PK  CR-0233 TRANSFERS: COUNTER ACCOUNT, FROM THE FILLER. 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 MONTH-END INTEREST AND FEE CODES. 2003-05-19 MV  CR-0342 THE CARD FILE AND ITS CODES.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES AND READ THE FIRST ACCOUNT. THE TRANSACTION RECORD STARTS BLANK: NO COUNTER ACCOUNT.

paragraphs.name: 1200-READ-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.description: READ THE NEXT ACCOUNT AND ITS ACCRUAL, WHICH MUST MATCH.

paragraphs.name: 2000-CHARGE-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.description: WRITE AN ACCOUNT'S INTEREST AND FEE, IF ITS MONTH CLOSED.

paragraphs.name: 2100-SETTLE-INTEREST
paragraphs.description: CREDIT THE INTEREST DUE, OR CHARGE IT IF THE ACCOUNT WAS OVERDRAWN.

paragraphs.name: 2200-CHARGE-FEE
paragraphs.description: CHARGE THE MAINTENANCE FEE: OPEN CURRENT ACCOUNTS ONLY, AND NOT IF THE MONTH CLOSED AT OR ABOVE THE WAIVER BALANCE.

paragraphs.name: 2900-WRITE-TRAN
paragraphs.description: WRITE THE TRANSACTION FOR THE ACCOUNT, WITH THE NEXT ID.

paragraphs.name: 9900-ABORT
paragraphs.description: STOP THE RUN WITH RETURN CODE 16, SAYING WHY.
